75N910-27-R-0044.relativeImportance: Technical Capability and Key Personnel are of equal importance and each is more important than Past Performance. Non-price factors combined are approximately equal to Price.

factors.name: Technical Capability
factors.criteria: The Government will evaluate the offeror's architecture for a secure, scalable research data platform, its protection of controlled-access human-subjects data, and its approach to self-service analytics for intramural researchers.
factors.sourceQuote: The Government will evaluate the offeror's architecture for a secure, scalable research data platform, its protection of controlled-access human-subjects data, and its approach to self-service analytics for intramural researchers.

factors.name: Key Personnel
factors.criteria: The Government will evaluate the qualifications, relevant experience and committed availability of the proposed Program Manager and Chief Data Architect.
factors.sourceQuote: The Government will evaluate the qualifications, relevant experience and committed availability of the proposed Program Manager and Chief Data Architect.

factors.name: Past Performance
factors.criteria: The Government will assess confidence based on recent and relevant performance on research data, health IT or scientific computing efforts.
factors.sourceQuote: The Government will assess confidence based on recent and relevant performance on research data, health IT or scientific computing efforts.

factors.name: Price
factors.criteria: Price will be evaluated for reasonableness. Total evaluated price is the sum of fixed-price CLINs and T&M ceilings for all periods.
factors.sourceQuote: Price will be evaluated for reasonableness. Total evaluated price is the sum of fixed-price CLINs and T&M ceilings for all periods.

75N910-27-R-0044.openQuestions: Section M states non-price factors combined are approximately equal to Price; confirm Price's position in the importance order.

FA8771-27-R-0012.relativeImportance: Technical Approach is more important than Management Approach, which is more important than Past Performance. All non-price factors combined are significantly more important than Price.

factors.name: Technical Approach
factors.criteria: The Government will evaluate the soundness and feasibility of the offeror's approach to migrating 140 mission applications to the Air Force cloud environment, including methodology, automation, cybersecurity and continuous ATO monitoring, and rationalization of legacy applications.
factors.sourceQuote: The Government will evaluate the soundness and feasibility of the offeror's approach to migrating 140 mission applications to the Air Force cloud environment, including methodology, automation, cybersecurity and continuous ATO monitoring, and rationalization of legacy applications.

factors.name: Management Approach
factors.criteria: The Government will evaluate the offeror's staffing plan and key personnel qualifications, the realism of the 60-day transition-in plan, and the offeror's approach to identifying and mitigating program risk.
factors.sourceQuote: The Government will evaluate the offeror's staffing plan and key personnel qualifications, the realism of the 60-day transition-in plan, and the offeror's approach to identifying and mitigating program risk.

factors.name: Past Performance
factors.criteria: The Government will assess its confidence that the offeror will successfully perform, based on recent (within 5 years) and relevant performance on efforts of similar size, scope and complexity, using CPARS, FAPIIS and references.
factors.sourceQuote: The Government will assess its confidence that the offeror will successfully perform, based on recent (within 5 years) and relevant performance on efforts of similar size, scope and complexity, using CPARS, FAPIIS and references.

factors.name: Price
factors.criteria: Price will be evaluated for reasonableness and balance. Total evaluated price is the sum of all CLINs for the base and option periods.
factors.sourceQuote: Price will be evaluated for reasonableness and balance. Total evaluated price is the sum of all CLINs for the base and option periods.
